entries.zh: 忙：忙碌；因事务繁忙而奔忙、赶紧
entries.en: to be busy with business/affairs; to hasten, hurry up

entries.zh: 忙迫：匆忙急迫
entries.en: hurried and hard-pressed; in urgent haste

entries.zh: 忙忙：匆匆忙忙，非常忙碌
entries.en: in great haste; very busy, hurriedly

entries.zh: 急：急速、赶快；急切
entries.en: quick, hasty; urgent, diligent (diligente)

entries.zh: 急计人：急切催促人赶快
entries.en: to urge someone to hasten; hasty dispatch
entries.notes: 汉字「計」取义不定（催促／谋计两读），据西语 diligencia 与词头语境取「急切催人」义。

entries.zh: 急心：心急、焦急
entries.en: hasty, anxious heart; impatience

entries.zh: 急性：急性子，性情急躁
entries.en: hasty temper; impetuous nature

entries.zh: 急迫：紧急迫切
entries.en: urgent and pressing; imminent haste

entries.zh: 急促：（动作、声息）急促短快
entries.en: hurried and abrupt; rapid

entries.zh: 神速：疾如神速，极其迅速
entries.en: marvelously swift; speed as of a spirit

entries.zh: 心急：心里着急，性急
entries.en: impatient, anxious at heart

entries.zh: 心火：心中焦躁上火；中医所谓心火
entries.en: heart-fire; burning agitation within

entries.zh: 按：按压
entries.en: to press (down)

entries.zh: 按带：按住、扣紧带子
entries.en: to press/tighten a strap or band (with a hook)

entries.zh: 按落去：按下去，压下
entries.en: to press something down (on/into it)

entries.zh: 压印（在印刷机上压印）；挤压
entries.en: to impress/press in a printing press; to squeeze out
entries.notes: 汉字「擲／榨」两读歧异，据西语 emprenta（印刷机）取「压」义。

entries.zh: 以杵槌捣压；当（搪住、抵受）
entries.en: to pound/press with a mallet (mazo)
entries.notes: 疑 maci 即 maço（槌）；汉字「當」与槌捣义的对应含推断成分。

entries.zh: 捣压使紧（当乞伊紧：压它使它紧实）
entries.en: to pound it down with a mallet so that it is pressed tight
entries.notes: M 栏中音节污损（[残]／T99），释义依 H/L/R 其余三栏补足。

entries.zh: 迫：逼迫，压迫
entries.en: to press/oppress someone; to afflict him

entries.zh: 迫紧：紧紧逼迫，加紧压迫
entries.en: to press hard and tight; to afflict sorely

entries.zh: 用手抓捏、揉按
entries.en: to squeeze/clutch with the hand; to press it
entries.notes: 汉字三候选「抙／揸／拄」歧异，据官话对音取「揸」（抓捏按压）义。

entries.zh: 抙死：攥死、捏死（攥握致死）
entries.en: to squeeze to death with the hand

entries.zh: 捻紧：捏紧，捻紧
entries.en: to pinch and twist tight

entries.zh: 捻带：捻紧带子，勒紧束带
entries.en: to pinch/tighten a strap or band; to cinch
